style_findings.name: Butterfly Cut
style_findings.observation: Both outputs shorten long hair into a smooth bob with fringe. Long lower lengths and distinct Butterfly layers are absent. The blonde source changes to black.
style_findings.next: Do not enable as Butterfly; current tested prompt/adapter fails its stated shape.

style_findings.name: Textured French Bob with Wispy Bangs
style_findings.observation: Both outputs show a visibly different curly, rounded bob with separated bangs. This is the closest candidate, but strongly curls the texture and changes the blonde source to black. It is not an unqualified preservation pass.
style_findings.next: Show the exact outputs for client/stylist review of the curly interpretation and color limits. Keep disabled until explicit acceptance and remaining production checks.

style_findings.name: Wolf Cut
style_findings.observation: Shorter crown/longer back is present, but both outputs are dominated by exaggerated stiff spikes and dark scene/punk-like hair. The blonde source changes to black; this does not meet a natural salon-preview standard.
style_findings.next: Do not present this tested profile as a reliable natural Wolf Cut.

style_findings.name: Korean Two-Block
style_findings.observation: Both outputs have a dense, rounded long fringe. The color example covers the eyes; clear shorter lower-side separation is not established. The baseline preserves visible short sides more clearly.
style_findings.next: Hold; a long bowl-like fringe alone is not evidence of the requested two-block shape.

style_findings.name: Korean Comma Hair
style_findings.observation: The detached ring/U artifact is reduced, but outputs stay close to Curtain Hair. The color example still drapes strands across the eyes/nose, and a clearly distinct reliable comma shape is not established on both inputs.
style_findings.next: Do not enable a nearly duplicate Curtain result under a new label.
